no_metrics_hub: This hub has no monitoring data yet. Deploy the new hub and the node on this computer, then check again.
not_found_detail: The hub's config has no “{id}”. It may have been removed or renamed.
route_hint: How the hub reaches this computer
unreachable: The hub can't reach this computer
agents_offline: The machine is offline. Its agents show up once it's back
agents_failed_detail: Couldn't load this computer's agents. Trying again in a moment.
metrics_note: Monitoring history is kept for 24 hours: a point every 10 s for the last hour, every minute before that. Gaps while disconnected aren't joined.
launchers_offline: The machine is offline. They show up once it's back
just_started: Recording just started. A chart shows up here shortly.
offline_range: This machine wasn't connected in the last {range}, so there's no data.
rename_hint: Shown in every app and on this computer's Persona Link. Leave it empty to use the id; the id stays the same.
screen_hint: Open this Mac's live screen (Screen Sharing)
machine_switch_link_intro: Connected over SSH. With Persona Link, this computer connects to the hub by itself, also from other networks.
machine_switch_link_body_what: Persona installs Persona Link on this computer over its current SSH connection, so the computer connects to the hub by itself, also from other networks.
machine_switch_link_body_reconnect: The computer disconnects and reconnects once. Agents running in a terminal keep running, but a reply the assistant is writing on it at that moment stops.
machine_switch_link_body_kept: Its name, settings and history stay. If something fails, it goes back to SSH.
machine_switch_link_steps: Steps of the switch to Persona Link
machine_switch_link_rolling_back: That didn't work. Putting the computer back on SSH…
machine_switch_link_succeeded: Switched to Persona Link. This computer now connects to the hub by itself.
machine_switch_link_failed: Couldn't switch to Persona Link. {reason} It's back on SSH.
machine_switch_link_failed_unconfirmed: Couldn't switch to Persona Link. {reason} Persona couldn't confirm that the switch was undone. Check that the computer is reachable; if it isn't, reconnect it from the computer itself.
machine_switch_link_forbidden: This device can't switch computers. Use a device with full access.
machine_switch_link_uncertain: Couldn't confirm that the switch started. If nothing changes here, try again.
machine_switch_link_why_offline: The computer needs to be online to switch.
machine_switch_link_why_unsupported_os: Switching from here works for Linux computers. On a Mac or Windows computer, install Persona Link on it yourself.
machine_switch_link_why_link_unavailable: The hub doesn't take Persona Link connections yet. Turn on its TLS port or give it an https address first, under Network & access on the hub's admin page.
machine_switch_link_why_hub_old: The hub needs an update before it can switch computers.
machine_switch_link_why_pending: Confirm that this computer is yours first.
machine_switch_link_why_custom_node: Persona runs from a custom location on this computer, so it can't be switched from here.
machine_switch_link_why_unsafe_permissio: Persona's folders on this computer aren't safe to switch from here: the home folder, ~/.persona or ~/.persona/bin belongs to another user or can be changed by other users. On that computer, make them yours and writable only by you (for example: chmod go-w ~ ~/.persona ~/.persona/bin), then try again.
machine_switch_link_why_hub_unanswered: The hub didn't answer for an hour, so the switch couldn't be undone.
machine_switch_link_why_busy: Persona is updating this computer. Try again once that's done.
machine_switch_link_why_in_progress: This computer is already switching to Persona Link.
machine_switch_link_why_no_systemd: This computer has no systemd user services, which Persona Link needs to keep running.
machine_switch_link_why_linger_off: Its services would stop whenever you sign out. An administrator of that computer must run {command} first.
machine_switch_link_why_existing_link: Persona Link is already installed or paired on this computer. Finish setting it up there, or remove it first.
machine_switch_link_why_no_node: Persona couldn't find its program on this computer in the usual place.
machine_switch_link_why_no_package: The hub has no Persona Link build for this computer's system.
machine_switch_link_why_transfer_failed: Couldn't send Persona Link to the computer over SSH.
machine_switch_link_why_install_failed: Persona Link couldn't be installed or paired on the computer.
machine_switch_link_why_link_timeout: The computer didn't connect through Persona Link in time.
machine_switch_link_why_config_changed: The computer's settings changed during the switch.
machine_switch_link_why_unavailable: This computer can't switch to Persona Link right now.
manager_pending_restart_hint: Binary updated with Redeploy. This assistant will restart automatically once idle.
manager_version_lag_hint: This assistant is still running an older version than this computer's node. Restart its manager service to apply.
workspaces_failed: Couldn’t load all workspaces. Trying again shortly.
